decision.explanation: The question asks for the location of the Central Square Historic District. Two distinct districts share the same name: one in Bristol, New Hampshire (D1S1-D1S3), and another in Stoneham, Massachusetts (D2S1-D2S3). Each is independently valid and refers to separate locations. The third answer provides a specific geographic description of the Bristol district (D1S2), which complements rather than contradicts the broader location 'Bristol, New Hampshire'. All three are directly supported by the original sources and should be retained.
